selection_rule: ID-based fixed subset, not outcome-based; chosen after accuracy experiments
warmup: one per method and dataset, first selected sorted ID, excluded
io_timer: separate cached image/FoV/reference decode per image; excludes hash checks, not cold disk
excluded: config loading, hash checks, metrics, mask verification, disk writes, GC between runs
threads: OpenCV 1; numerical thread environment requested 1, not OS affinity enforcement
power_thermal_state: not instrumented; user instructed AC power and idle machine
cap_policy: 500000 unchanged; cap reached is not proof frontier remains
scope: Historical DRIVE subset of a broader experiment; six images, two reported methods, five repetitions. Not a whole-dataset estimate.
order: Archived values retain original positions in a rotating three-method schedule; the additional method is outside this package. New two-method runs use their own schedule and are not identical timing conditions.
prediction_validation: Every archived repetition was checked against stored confusion counts and metrics.
